instruction: I want to disable the global play/pause hotkey in VLC because it conflicts with other applications. How can I turn off this global keyboard shortcut?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
